tasks.title: Proxmox community helper script + submission
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/006-platform-expansion/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/platforms.feature}. SECOND: write releases/platforms/proxmox/install-cubeos-lxc.sh per REQ-600/601/602. Test against PVE 9. Submit PR to community-scripts repo.
